description: This file defines the IRuntimeClient interface and related helper class in the Orleans framework. It declares the core runtime client API, including methods for managing request/response cycle, object references, and runtime configurations.

classes.name: OnDeserializedCallbacks
classes.description: Helper class to invoke OnDeserialized method after deserialization, holding references to IServiceProvider and IRuntimeClient.

methods.name: OnDeserializedCallbacks(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
methods.description: Constructor initializing ServiceProvider and RuntimeClient references.

methods.name: OnDeserialized(IOnDeserialized value)
methods.description: Invokes the OnDeserialized method on the provided object.
